title: Paired index
statement: For natural numbers $r$ and $k$, define an index on the disjoint union of two copies of $\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$. It sends the first copy's index $j$ to $r+2j$ and the second copy's index $j$ to $r+2j+1$, in each case as an element of $\{0,\ldots,r+2k-1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: the input belongs to one of two copies of the indices less than $k$
